notes: Source identity: Sloman and Rabb, Your Understanding Is My Understanding; supplied canonical text contains Experiment 2 Method and Results on printed pp. 1454–1455. Recruitment N=146 and 40 attention-check/external-website exclusions are explicit. The critical-model analytic N is not printed, nor are mutually exclusive final group counts. Candidate subtraction 146 - 40 = 106 is retained only for parent review; N is not inferred from df. All conditions are within participants, so condition counts cannot be summed. Unassigned fields/sides are placeholders only. Candidate tests are the three-condition ANOVA F(2, 210) = 5.62, p = .004, partial eta-squared .051; public CK/public no-CK t(105) = −3.20, p = .002; and public CK/secret CK t(105) = −1.96, p = .052. Public CK descriptive M = 0.21, 95% CI [0.16, 0.25]. No d printed for these Experiment 2 tests. None selected; study number retained rather than substituted by page number.
